name: Optimized Ray-marching algorithm
tagline: Faster ray-marched terrain using distance-based detail and bounded sphere tracing.

awards: Huawei Custom Challenge #1: Interactive Landscape Graphics

problem: The sponsor's baseline ray-marcher rendered procedural terrain too slowly.
solution: Level-of-detail noise that drops fine detail with distance and Lipschitz-bounded sphere tracing to take larger safe steps.
demo_moment: Team-described: real-time terrain with the optimisations applied.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Huawei Custom Challenge #1: Interactive Landscape Graphics” among 217 submissions.
A solo entry focused purely on the algorithm.

lessons: On an algorithm challenge, explain each optimisation and its effect.
